records.text: Israel began evacuating Lebanese villages north of the Litani River, indicating expansion beyond southern Lebanon.
records.speaker: Ana Kasparian

appearances.snippet: yeah we're just going to take southern Lebanon and then by the way they've begun evacuating villages north of the Litani river meaning oh no it's not just southern Lebanon and so when people fear monger about groups like Hezbollah for instance which is supported by Iran

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms that the Israeli military ordered evacuations of multiple Lebanese villages north of the Litani River, including locations deep inside the country. That is geographic expansion beyond the initial area south of the river.

sources.title: Israeli army orders evacuation of dozens of villages in south Lebanon
sources.relevance: Identifies 29 villages north of the Litani under evacuation orders.

sources.title: Israel planning massive ground invasion of Lebanon, officials say
sources.relevance: Reports evacuation orders expanding for the first time north of the Litani.
